items.title: 新 EIP：Keystore 过期 actor 清理
items.note: （chunter-cb）提交，标注 WIP，据 Ethereal news #37 为 EIP-8396。两部分：布局在上线时就写死，actor 的 `actor_config`、`policy_manager`、`policy_commitment` 作为共置、步长对齐的 3 字记录，`actor_config` 预留区设 `CLEANABLE` 标记位；清理器尽力而为，每个区块从按区块种子确定的位置扫描有限数量的记录头，清理过期 actor。
items.title_en: New EIP: Keystore expired actor pruning
items.note_en: (chunter-cb), submitted and marked WIP; EIP-8396 per Ethereal news #37. It has two parts: a layout enshrined at launch, fixing an actor's `actor_config`, `policy_manager` and `policy_commitment` as a co-located, stride-aligned 3-word record with a `CLEANABLE` marker bit in the `actor_config` reserved region; and a best-effort reaper that, each block, walks a bounded number of record heads from a deterministic block-seeded position and clears expired actors.

items.title: EIP-8037：SYSTEM_MAX_SSTORES_PER_CALL 与请求上限解耦
items.note: （chfast）提交并合并。原理由是等于 `MAX_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK`，但该常量计的是出队记录，出队并不写记录槽，且 EIP-8282 新增的系统合约每块上限更大；改为声明余量并写明重新推导的条件。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: decouple SYSTEM_MAX_SSTORES_PER_CALL from request bounds
items.note_en: (chfast), submitted and merged. The value was justified as matching `MAX_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK`, but that constant counts records dequeued, dequeuing writes no record slots, and the system contract added by EIP-8282 has a larger per-block bound; the value is now stated as a margin with an explicit re-derivation condition.

summary_en: chunter-cb submitted a companion EIP to EIP-8130 for consensus-driven pruning of expired actors, bounding Keystore state growth from short-lived actors such as session keys and subscriptions. Mike Neuder published "ePBS, distilled", outlining ePBS in its final form and its effect on MEV markets. The justification for EIP-8037's system call storage write bound was corrected and merged. AA (Frame Tx) breakout #2 was held in the evening.
